name: cerebral arteriopathy, autosomal dominant, with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy, type 1
description: A CADASIL characterized by migraine, strokes, and white matter lesions that has material basis in heterozygous mutation in the NOTCH3 gene on chromosome 19p13.
